items.html: Nijman was picked in the Netherlands squad for the 2003 World Cup, and though he has been a part of their set-up since, his job as a doctor and injuries have affected his availability. He was part of the National Youth Development Program and has represented Netherlands at all youth levels. A member of the XI that beat England in the opening game of the World Twenty20 in 2009, Nijman has been a successful medium-pacer at the national level and hopes to make his mark in the international arena.
